title: No Evidence for Millimeter Continuum Source Overdensities in the Environments of z ≳ 6 Quasars
question: Do 1.2 mm continuum source counts in ALMA Band 6 fields around 35 z>6 quasars show an overdensity relative to blank-field number counts, as expected for early protoclusters?

what.value: Blank-field 1.2 mm number counts Schechter fit (phi*, alpha, S*) used for injected sources and expected counts

evidence.quote: The Schechter model we choose is based on the most recent blank field 1.2 mm number counts compilation of (cite: Fujimoto2016a) valid for flux densities of 0.1-1.5 mJy
1- (cite: Banados2016a); 2- Venemans et al. (in prep); 3- (cite: Carnall2015a)

external_data.citation: (cite: Banados2016a) and others in Table 1 notes

what.value: [CII] companion sources from earlier ALMA work shown for comparison

evidence.quote: three \[CII\] sources found in (cite: Decarli2017a) and (cite: Willott2017a) which are not found in continuum here

what.value: Protocluster overdensity profile model used to predict expected delta_gal

evidence.quote: (cite: Chiang2013a) uses semi-analytical models of protocluster evolution to predict their overdensity profiles out to $z=5$ in cubes of (15 cMpc)$^3$.

recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, CLEAN with natural weighting to 3σ, original resolution

recipe.goal: Mask quasar and build SNR maps
recipe.method: Mask 4"x4" around quasar; divide by continuum RMS (no primary beam correction); trim to PB>50%

recipe.goal: Choose detection threshold via mock observations
recipe.method: 1000 simulated noise maps with Schechter-injected unresolved sources, convolved with 0.8"x0.5" beam; region-growing source finder; completeness and contamination vs SNR
key_parameters: source = two or more adjacent pixels above 5σ
assumptions: Injected sources unresolved and unclustered; blank-field Fujimoto2016 Schechter counts

recipe.method: Per-source weight xi=(1-f)/(C A_eff), summed in 6 log bins of 0.25 dex; Poisson errors plus completeness/contamination uncertainty
delta_gal=(N_gal-N_exp)/N_exp using Fujimoto2016 expected counts over effective area; also radial dependence test

answer_key.quantity: Number of continuum sources detected at ≥5σ

evidence.quote: The results from the source-finding algorithm reveal a total of 15 candidate detections in the 35 fields
completeness of 91.6% and contamination of 4.3% at a $5\sigma$ detection threshold
completeness of 91.6% and contamination of 4.3% at a $5\sigma$ detection threshold
we would expect $N_{\rm exp} = 16.1^{+3.3}_{-6.8}$ sources between 0.1-10 mJy in these fields without an overdensity
our measured number of sources $N_{\rm gal}$ is 15.1$\pm$5.7
this implies a value of $\delta_{\rm gal} = -0.07\pm0.56$
The deepest data have a flux limit of 0.15 mJy beam$^{-1}$ and the maximum effective area is 4.3 arcmin$^2$.

answer_key.quantity: Predicted 2D delta_gal if quasars sit at protocluster peak

evidence.quote: or a 2D $\delta_{\rm gal} \approx 0.3$ when including the expected millimeter foreground sources
